# kakapo v2026.11.26

Release date: 2026-11-26 (Asia/Shanghai).

Update the build to Go 1.27.4, Wails v3.1.0 and Bun 1.4.5 with the current frontend/system dependencies. This replaces the previous Wails beta build baseline. Existing credential recovery markers and storage safety boundaries remain applicable; this release does not introduce a new data migration. The macOS universal bundle retains an ad-hoc signature; it is not Developer ID notarization.

## Upgrade and rollback

Retain the previous exact program/image and back up configuration before rollout. Stop affected writers during replacement; validate the actual configured user path in staging. Restore the complete previous dependency lockfiles when rebuilding an older source version.

Full changes: https://github.com/soulteary/kakapo/compare/v2026.11.02...v2026.11.26

Credential recovery and persistence boundaries from [v2026.11.02](https://github.com/soulteary/kakapo/releases/tag/v2026.11.02) remain applicable: finish pending credential recovery before rollback; do not mix versions or remove recovery markers.
